info.title: API.SH: Rakuten
info.description: The Rakuten API from API.SH: public Rakuten data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
One Rakuten Ichiba genre: name, link, breadcrumbs, its subgenres (id, name, item count, link) and its products (id, title, price, shop, rating, reviews, images, link), with the sort, price and free-shipping filters. Without `genre` it lists every top-level genre (with its section and main subgenres). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/rakuten-category

parameters.name: genre
parameters.description: Rakuten genre id (e.g. 100371 Women's fashion); empty = list the top-level genres.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A genre link (search.rakuten.co.jp/search/mall/-/<genre>/) instead of genre.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order (default standard).

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Lowest price (yen).

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Highest price (yen).

parameters.name: free_shipping
parameters.description: 1 = free shipping only.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1, 45 per page, up to 150).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Items for a search on Rakuten Ichiba (Japan): title, price (JPY, tax included) and price range across variants, review score and count, shop, shipping fee and delivery text, points, sold-out flag, variant attributes, tags and images, used flag and used condition, the coupons the search card lists, 45 per page (the site has no other page size). Filter by price, genre, shop, free shipping, delivery speed, minimum rating, condition (new or used) and excluded words; applied filters are echoed in `applied_filters`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page (Rakuten shows at most 150 pages).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/rakuten-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords (Japanese or English).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: price_shipping_asc / price_shipping_desc: by price including shipping; reviews: most reviewed; rating: best rated.

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Lowest price, whole yen.

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Highest price, whole yen.

parameters.name: genre
parameters.description: Only this Rakuten genre (category) id, e.g. 560202; ids are in each product's `genres`.

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Only items from this shop (the numeric shop id, a product's `shop.id`).

parameters.name: free_shipping
parameters.description: true: only items with free shipping.

parameters.name: delivery
parameters.description: next_day: only items delivered the next day; two_days: delivered within two days.

parameters.name: include_sold_out
parameters.description: true: include sold-out items (left out by default).

parameters.name: min_rating
parameters.description: Only items with at least this review score: 3.5, 4 or 4.5.

parameters.name: exclude
parameters.description: Leave out items matching these words.

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: Only new or only used items (each product carries `used` and `used_condition`).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
